set -eu
cd /home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = a6a84876ab8ff9a81503ac15d1a3285e50634e1e
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,urllib.request
base="http://127.0.0.1:8787"
old="realdebug_6cf69ffdd7f641cba693aa2e9783c9aa"
ids=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker","exec","debug-ai-debug-ai-1","node","-e","const fs=require('node:fs');console.log(JSON.stringify(fs.readdirSync('/app/runtime').filter(x=>/^realdebug_[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(x))))"],text=True))
for bid in ids:
    if bid==old: continue
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(base+"/v1/investigation-benchmark/status/"+bid,timeout=5) as r: s=json.load(r)
    except Exception: continue
    if s.get("active_in_process"):
        assert s["summary"]["total"]==50
        print("ACTIVE_FIFTY",json.dumps({k:s.get(k) for k in ("benchmark_id","state","active_in_process","current","summary","started_at","updated_at")}),flush=True)
        break
else:
    raise SystemExit("NO_ACTIVE_FIFTY")
PY
